apk_artifact.name: immortal-world-debug-apk
apk_artifact.digest_source: GitHub artifact API; archive digest, not an independently measured APK digest

verified_additions: Automatic create-to-narrator path waits for provider restoration and persists the character before streaming
Opening context captures all visible creation choices, excludes private data and does not consult later mutable campaign fields
Actual HTTP/SSE opening request and prompt budgets tested with a local mock server
Create and regenerate UI controls tested on API 26 and 35 through a controlled narrator dependency
Failed first generation, invalid replacement, cancellation, late tokens and duplicate submission recovery
Explicit offline mode makes no narration request; enabling AI permits manual generation
Cold-start settings restoration, fresh ViewModel load, portable import and independent copy regeneration
Legacy untouched opening generation is explicit; progressed campaigns never receive invented origins
Opening and latest-action regeneration preserve RNG, time, character, resources, quests, NPCs and mechanical outcomes
v3 opening/prose roundtrip and origin retention within the existing bounded history
All previous endpoint, provider, encryption, Room, save, gameplay and native UI regressions retained
remaining_manual_acceptance: Physical-phone install, SAF providers, force-stop, rotation, TalkBack, IME and larger accessibility fonts
Live compatible AI provider with user-supplied credentials, network recovery and measured response latency
Physical-device Android Keystore and profile review
Live CrowLLM account access and its actual model catalog with user-owned credentials
Live opening quality based on selected premise, first-request/regeneration cancellation and lifecycle on a physical phone
not_implemented: Large procedural worlds and autonomous NPC plots
Advanced sect management, group combat and arbitrary generated mechanics
Whole-site crawling or protected-site bypass (intentionally excluded)
On-device GGUF inference or native Cloudflare account configuration
Selectable higher-realm creation or independent decorative root-quality mechanics

test_boundaries.device_opening_flows: Controlled narrator injected into GameViewModel; real Room persistence and Compose controls
test_boundaries.provider_wire: Actual CompatibleStoryteller HTTP and SSE against MockWebServer; no real paid API credentials
test_boundaries.first_failure_resolution: Corrected missing finish_reason=stop in new SSE fixture; no production validation weakened
